scope_label: assessable characteristic consequential to a customer need
definition: A critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristic is an assessable feature of a product, service, or process whose performance matters materially to meeting a customer need.
explanation: CTQ work translates a broad need into characteristics and requirements that can be checked. The link between the need and the characteristic should be made explicit.
Calling a characteristic “critical” does not make every available measure relevant. Its priority and acceptable performance must be justified for the particular customer and use.
